artifact.transcript:
AI: Thanks for calling Cavern Electrical. You've reached our after-hours line. I'm an automated assistant and this call is recorded so the team can follow up. What's going on tonight?
User: Half of the house lost power about an hour ago and the breaker keeps tripping when I reset it.
AI: Okay. Any burning smell, sparks, or anything hot to the touch?
User: No, nothing like that. The furnace is on the other side, so we still have heat.
AI: Good. Can I get your name and best number?
User: Gus Hartley. 612-555-0123.
AI: And your address, Gus?
User: 5 Wren Hollow Road.
AI: Thanks. Please leave that breaker off for now. I'll have the team call you first thing in the morning.
User: Sounds good, as early as possible please.
